mcqs.question: When seedlings fail, where do you investigate first?

options.text: I compare roots, moisture, and light before changing anything. Several causes can leave the same sad leaves.
I change one condition and leave the others alone. A smaller experiment gives failure somewhere useful to go.
I would keep one small bed for repeat trials. It could make uncertainty visible without putting the whole harvest at risk.

mcqs.rationale: The correct option reproduces the answer to this held-out question; the alternatives come from related answers or reverse its intent.
